verdict.rationale: First-party sources say Svelte is a compiler that turns declarative components into efficient JavaScript that 'surgically updates the DOM' and does minimal work in the browser. That is a compile-time, direct-DOM-update approach rather than runtime diffing. Community users corroborate that it compiles to imperative JavaScript, produces readable output and performs well after migrating from React. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that there is no virtual DOM diffing step, and in-depth docs or benchmarks on how the compiled update mechanism works.
